text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Today is the last day of the summer 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is not much time left until the 
Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho... Chiyono O-san and 
Ardan-san will both be sitting it out to 
nurse their injuries.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san isn't running in the Kikuka Sho 
either. Besides her low long-distance 
aptitude, she said she still lacked the 
training to challenge a GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Who else might be entering the race...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! That is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Oh, Yaeno. Did you need something 
from me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There is something I would like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Will you be running in the Kikuka Sho, 
Oguri-san?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I won't run... the Kikuka-sho. I will run 
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: “The Tenno Sho (Autumn)!? Why?!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Because Tama is running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-san... is that you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to run with Tama. And I want 
to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama told me she wants to run with me, 
too. That's why I'm entering the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno, you're entering the Kikuka Sho, 
right? If you ran in the Satsuki Sho and 
the Nippon Derby, the third one's gotta be 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Creek is running in the Kikuka Sho. Her 
stamina is incredible. So, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much.

I pack my luggage and leave the training 
camp lodge. Though it is still early for 
the meetup time, Yaeno Muteki is already 
at the front entrance.

However, she is deep in thought with a 
complicated expression.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer. I just heard from 
Oguri-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I hear Creek-san will be running in the 
Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: I see, your injury has healed up.
I see, so your injury is all healed.

text_block_list.text:
Super Creek—she is also one of Yaeno 
Muteki's classmates from the Twinkle 
Series debut class.

Super Creek, who has a knack for staying, 
had set her sights on the Nippon Derby, 
but was forced to withdraw due to injury.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek, who's rumored to be a stayer, is 
entering the long-distance Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt that she will be a 
formidable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She gives off a strong impression of being 
gentle and laid-back, but you can't let 
your guard down.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's come up with a solid plan.
Yeah. Let's come up with a solid plan.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

With a clear vision firmly set for the 
Kikuka Sho, the summer training camp came 
to a close.
